rows.evidence: unknown-call-review-service.ts:801's false arm is a cache hit for a SECOND process item of the same round (:792 map, :799-804). Review items are the Kernel Turn's started/running calls, the Kernel serializes non-read-only calls, and the only process tool in the L3 table is shell (state/unknown-call-kinds.ts:40), so one crashed Run leaves one process item (slice-K3-SPEC.md:1786; tests/work-graph/K3-06-mixed-kinds-owner.test.ts:6-12; evidence books/k3-multicall-facts.out.md: 32 shell calls still yield one process item). A conclusion needs the round Run running (unknown-call-review-service.ts:559-573, :582-587). The deleted test built two process items by hand (./.dsh-ref/before/tests/work-graph/UCR-settle-review.test.ts:278-294), which T1-061 ruled unreachable.
rows.proposal_note: Delete the per-round cache (:792, :799-804) and read the display for the one process item; no test asserts a call count now. Restate the 'one read per round' comment at :784 and add the postscript at slice-K3-SPEC §10 / decision 75.

rows.evidence: unknown-call-review-service.ts:805's then-arm needs the production display reader to return not_found. That reader (composition/create-platform.ts:737-748) returns it only when readExecution is not_found (:739) or the round Run's envelope is null (:742-743). A conclusion is recorded only while the round Run is running (:559-573, :582-587); running implies authorization wrote the envelope (run-machine.ts:853-860, :875-880), and Runs are never deleted, so an earlier round that recorded a conclusion still exists with its envelope. Only a removed/edited Run record reaches :805. The before test injected a fake reader returning not_found (./.dsh-ref/before/tests/work-graph/UCR-settle-review.test.ts:264-269); T1-061 rewired it to a real artifact-body failure, which ends at :812 (tests/work-graph/UCR-settle-review.test.ts:200-230).
